messages:
Alex: Hey folks — PR #58099 is ready for cross-team review. It adjusts fallback routing and adds a small opt-in header-preserve path. Need runtime + platform + infra + security eyes. Link: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/58099

Alex: Main callouts: small perf delta in local load tests (~+2.5% p95 at scale), and a header-order change that could affect auth validators. Planning a flag-gated canary.

Priya: I can take platform review. Will check the canary plan + dashboards. When are you hoping to merge?

Alex: Ideally tomorrow afternoon PST, but flexible if more verification is needed.

Jordan: I can look at the eviction/allocator interaction. Can you paste perf numbers and the bench command you ran?

Alex: Sure — quick bench snippet: `./bench -c 50000 --concurrency=500 --model=small --runs=3`
Bench summary: median +1.1%, p95 +2.8% at simulated 50k qps. Artifacts: gs://redwood-ci/pr-58099/perf/2026-03-14.json

Maya: Eng-sre can own canary rollout. I prefer a merge after we've got one green ~2-hour canary in staging and a smoke-check on the critical endpoints. I can schedule a canary slot 14:00 PST tomorrow.

sec-scan-bot: Security scan: potential header reordering issue flagged for auth validators. See full report: https://scans.redwood/security/58099 (severity: medium)

Sam: I'll pick up the security review in the morning. Quick question: is the header-order change enabled by default?

Alex: It's opt-in behind a feature flag `FALLBACK_HEADER_PRESERVE`. Default = false for canary. We'll add instructions in the PR description on how to flip it.

Priya: Flag gating sounds good. Please add a short note in the PR description that the flag defaults off and how to enable it for canary. Also include the dashboard links we should watch.

Jordan: Also need to see the k8s manifest diff and any new env vars. If it's just an env toggle that we set at rollout time, fine — otherwise I'll need a short config review.

Alex: No new k8s objects. We'll set `FALLBACK_HEADER_PRESERVE=true` on the runtime deployment for the canary podset only. I'll upload the manifest diff to the PR in a minute.

Maya: Adding to staging calendar now. @Priya @Sam if you can confirm by EOD PST today we'll proceed with the 14:00 slot tomorrow; otherwise I'll hold the merge until approvals are in place.

Priya: Noted — aiming to finish review by EOD. :thumbsup:

Sam: I'll priority-review first thing tomorrow. If I don't unblock, ping me at 09:30 PST.

Alex: Thanks everyone! I'll post the manifest diffs and the canary checklist in the PR — ping me if anything else is needed. :pray:
